title: OnboardingStep
description: A single check inside a gate. A field is only ever asked for once per playbook; the gate it sits in decides when it is due and who is asked.

type.description: What kind of check this is.

requirement.description: Whether the check holds the gate. Only blocking checks stop a transition; recommended and optional checks stay open as tasks.

assistance.description: Help offered to the person completing the check.

fieldPath.description: Field this check captures, e.g. `description` or `extension.accessRequestInfo`.

workflow.description: For `approval` checks, the workflow that records the decision.

conditions.description: Conditions are how one playbook covers a whole asset type, rather than competing playbooks.

guidance.description: Instructions for the person completing this step.

javaEnums.name: ATTRIBUTE
javaEnums.description: A field on the asset must be filled and pass a rule.

javaEnums.name: RELATIONSHIP
javaEnums.description: The asset must be linked to another asset - term, domain, contract.

javaEnums.name: RESPONSIBILITY
javaEnums.description: A role must be filled by a named person or group.

javaEnums.name: ASSESSMENT
javaEnums.description: An automated check or questionnaire must pass.

javaEnums.name: APPROVAL
javaEnums.description: A named role must sign off, using an existing workflow.

javaEnums.name: AI
javaEnums.description: Propose a value from lineage, usage and similar assets.

javaEnums.name: AUTOFILL
javaEnums.description: Prefill from other assets in the same domain.

javaEnums.name: EXAMPLE
javaEnums.description: Show a good example; the user still writes it.
